title: Header chrome and demo mode
goal: Theme, mode, accent, CRT, clock, build, Dummy Plug banner and the ?demo simulation are settled in the workspace
acceptance: Header controls and the Dummy Plug banner match the old page, using STYLE-GUIDE tokens
The demo simulation (dashboard.js) is ported as a fixture-driven mode or dropped with the owner's agreement; never mixed with live data
Theme is a setting over shared STYLE-GUIDE tokens used by both the full dashboard and the simple view: the plain (non-Evangelion) style is the default, EVA (with CRT) an optional theme
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
escalation: A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: the chrome is small; demo mode is the open question. Re-estimated 2026-11-25 (+0.5 h): themes become shared tokens for two layouts. Not a measurement.
